title.narrative: Promoting the uptake of the Fourth Industrial Revolution technologies in the Mogilev Region of Belarus

description.narrative: In December 2018, the Ministry of Economy of the Republic of Belarus (MoE) submitted a request to UNIDO for developing a project to promote the uptake of the Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR) technologies in manufacturing by establishing regional 4IR demonstration and innovation centers in the Brest, Vitebsk and Mogilev regions. The project was designed to facilitate technological learning and innovation of Small and Medium Sized Enterprises (SMEs) through the establishment of a pilot Industry 4.0 technology demonstration center allowing them to get access to and experiment with 4IR technologies, thus creating opportunities for manufacturers to generate new value added through design, customization, cutting costs, and resource efficiency. The Brest region was identified as the most promising for the implementation of the project #Leveraging the potential of 4IR technologies for smart manufacturing and ISID in Belarus#. The successful implementation of the project created the prerequisites for continued interaction between MoE, UNIDO and other stakeholders in the field of supporting the transition towards 4IR technologies in the Mogilev region. Based on the successful results achieved during the pilot project in Brest region, MoE requested UNIDO to extend its regional scope and develop an additional project aim
